ann: An electronic sign at the metro station reads "Classical special train - enjoy the music" as passengers wait on the platform.
A single flutist begins playing classical music in the crowded train car
Two women sitting on the train suddenly pull out flutes and begin playing classical music, catching the attention of the surrounding passengers.
A man sitting nearby joins the performance by playing the oboe, expanding the group of musicians.
The performance escalates as a man stands up in the aisle and begins playing the violin.
A young girl stares in awe at the musicians as the music builds and more string instruments join in.
The climax of the performance hits as the full orchestra plays together; passengers smile, cheer, and record the event on their phones.
A man in a red jacket stands up in the middle of the crowded train and begins passionately conducting the hidden orchestra.
A close-up shows a baby in a stroller looking around with wide-eyed curiosity as the classical music plays.
The train pulls into the final station, the doors open, and passengers smile as the performance concludes.
A text overlay reveals the flash mob is an advertisement for a classical music radio station
